title: panel keys pressed quickly act on the panel they reach
note: ⌥S, ⌥J, ⌥W as fast as a person types: ⌥W closes the panel ⌥J moved to (the page), not the one ⌥S landed on

known.thc-screen/real: thc-screen: panel keys pressed while an earlier one's act is in flight are lost: ⌥S ⌥J ⌥W quickly closes nothing (each act reads the stack and focus it was pressed against); with a pause between (S02) they work
